contact.basis: Exact independent clock-tower point fixed before original source field and all floors/main sections. Provider-relative host datum only, no surveyed foundation.

attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed original MarkarClockTowerPrimaryFacts2026 site-context frame with explicitly approximate component registration. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.

Composite source relief can contain water-level, canopy and DEM void artifacts; it is not bathymetry or an exposed foundation survey. Source field does not certify historic ground contact.
